snippet.title: Slots & Diapers - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The house always wins. Especially when it’s a mess.

This is the Demo Realese Trailer for Slots & Diapers — a satirical casino clicker where the machines (and the people playing them) suffer from a total lack of bowel control.

PLAY THE DEMO NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4409880 

WISHLIST ON STEAM:https://store.steampowered.com/app/4409870

Build a gambling empire with a crew of napping seniors, mine finite Mega Jackpots from "drained" machines, and manage a floor that gets stickier by the second. It’s high-dopamine growth mixed with a very specific, very gross janitorial loop.
We’re a two-person studio making the most absurd game we could imagine. If you enjoy the chaos, hitting the wishlist button tells the Steam algorithm that people actually like this kind of mess.
